topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by framing the learning outcomes and connecting the content to prior histopathology practicals.

topics.label: Viral origins of oncogenes and experimental transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the study of tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays for measuring cell transformation.

topics.label: Cancer mutation classifications and tumor suppressor mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the functional categories of cancer mutations and explore how tumor suppressors like Rb and p53 regulate cell cycle progression and phenotype based on allele dosage.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the molecular pathways and cellular defects in DNA repair, replication, and mitotic segregation that generate sequence and chromosomal instability.

topics.label: Multi-step tumor progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how sequential somatic mutations and inherited genetic predispositions accelerate tumor development and influence malignancy.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing with an offer for questions, recommended reading, and a preview of the next lecture.
